probe: P3S-01 · 只读清点（真库行数 + public 触发器计数口径）

rows.sql:
SELECT 'users' AS t, count(*)::text AS n FROM public.users
            UNION ALL SELECT 'account', count(*)::text FROM public.account
            UNION ALL SELECT 'ledger_entry', count(*)::text FROM public.ledger_entry
            UNION ALL SELECT 'currency', count(*)::text FROM public.currency
            UNION ALL SELECT 'referral', count(*)::text FROM public.referral

T1_public_not_internal.sql:
SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal

T2_public_all.sql:
SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public'

T3_public_not_internal_by_enabled.sql:
SELECT t.tgenabled::text AS en, count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

T4_public_all_by_enabled.sql:

     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

T8_public_all_by_relkind.sql:

     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

T9_public_all_by_tgisinternal.sql:

     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

T10_public_not_internal_by_tgparentid.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN t.tgparentid = 0 THEN 'parent=0' ELSE 'cloned(parent<>0)' END AS k, count(*)::text AS n
     FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
     WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

T11_public_rows_any_enabled_non_O.sql:
SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND t.tgenabled <> 'O'

T12_information_schema_public.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema = 'public'

T13_information_schema_all.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers

T14_information_schema_public_distinct.sql: SELECT (count(DISTINCT (trigger_schema, event_object_table, trigger_name)))::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema = 'public'

T15_pg_trigger_no_class_join.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid WHERE c.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace AND NOT t.tgisinternal

T16_pg_event_trigger.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_event_trigger

T17_public_not_internal_excl_partition_c.sql:
SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgparentid = 0

LIST_ALL_TRIGGERS.sql:
SELECT n.nspname AS ns, c.relname AS rel, c.relkind::text AS relkind, t.tgname AS trig,
    t.tgisinternal::text AS internal, t.tgenabled::text AS en, t.tgparentid::text AS parent,
    (t.tgconstraint <> 0)::text AS is_constraint, t.tgtype::text AS tgtype
  FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, t.tgname
